content_sections.heading: RCFL Management Trainee Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: RCFL has announced vacancies for Management Trainee posts in various disciplines. The post-wise vacancy details are given below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for RCFL Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates having the required educational qualifications in relevant disciplines can apply for different Management Trainee posts. The eligibility details are as follows: Management Trainee (Chemical): Candidates with B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering or relevant qualification. Management Trainee (Engineering Disciplines): Candidates with relevant engineering degrees in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, IT and other related fields. Management Trainee (Finance): Candidates with CA/CMA or relevant Finance qualification. Management Trainee (Marketing): Candidates with MBA/PG qualification in Marketing or related discipline. Management Trainee (Rajbhasha): Candidates with relevant Hindi/Language qualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCFL Management Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official RCFL website. Open the Recruitment section. Download and read the official notification carefully. Click on the online application link. Register using your email ID and mobile number. Fill out the application form with correct details. Upload required documents, photograph and signature. Pay the application fee, if applicable. Submit the application form and take a printout for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under RCFL Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCFL) has announced a total of 94 Management Trainee vacancies for various disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name in RCFL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name is Management Trainee in different disciplines including Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Finance, Marketing, IT and other fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the full form of RCFL?
faq.answer: RCFL stands for Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited, a Navratna Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the Government of India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the job location for RCFL Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selected candidates may be posted at Trombay, Thal and RCFL area offices across India as per company requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for RCFL Management Trainee posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have relevant qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech, MBA, CA, CMA or other required degrees depending on the Management Trainee discipline.
